what: The background photo panel behind the text stays fixed from when the panel top touches the top of the screen until the panel bottom touches the bottom of the screen, while the photo grows from .8× to 1 around the bottom center and the clip hiding the bottom 10% retracts to 0 (scrub 1, power1.out) — the backdrop of the section introducing the annex and sister brands slowly approaches and fills the screen

options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo that grows and has its clip lifted (inside the board, required)
options.scrub: Trailing delay (sec), default 1 — if true, immediate
options.pin: If ”false”, it doesn’t pin and grows as it passes by

from.where: index.html .kh-annex__area (original top.js Annex section: js-top-scale-target fromTo scale .8 · --clip 10% → 1 · 0%, clip-path inset(0 0 var(--clip) 0), transform-origin bottom center, trigger js-top-scale-area start top top · end bottom bottom, scrub 1, pin)
